notes: Shooter: a PvP sniper game on a small symmetric Call of Duty style arena, which is the Team Deathmatch preset on its default lane-network — two opposing ends with a handful of parallel routes across the middle is exactly what the referenced map is. I dropped the preset's choke-bottleneck because the author narrowed the game to snipers only, and pinching fights into narrow ground works against the long sightlines that decision asks for, and added cover-elevated for the raised perches and windows a sniper duel is fought from. That elevation is why the route carries tiered: I built the perches as raised positions with nothing overhanging rather than balconies, which keeps this off the P2 pipeline that is not ready yet. With no user to ask, I took the author's 2D home screen as menu UI with no geometry to build, so only the single arena is in scope, and left the houses as facades since nothing in the prompt says players fight indoors.
